name: Bourgogne-Franche-Comté
summary_text: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): Dijon / Cote-d'Or: rural traditional department. Regional evidence: the only prefecture in the country found to have twice banned a Pride march from its city centre with the ban upheld - on 12 June 2025 the prefecture prohibited the Pride 2025 march in central Dijon citing "risk of trouble to public order", the second consecutive year of the same restriction; the organisers' withdrawal citing LGBT visibility was itself called significant by the city. On 14 June 2025 the administrative court rejected the legal challenge, and the march (about 1,500 people per police) proceeded on a diverted route around the historic centre; the prefecture justified the ban by estimated organiser numbers (200 vs previous 2,500 and 1,500 turnouts) and a stated risk of violent individuals attaching themselves. The march itself passed peacefully ("joyful and festive, without a hitch") - the harm documented here is the restriction and its chilling effect, not violence. Scored relative to the national score (0.67) for France.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018): trans women incarcerated in the country on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal grey area and are punished beyond their alleged crimes - placement problems in the prison system. National prison-system context (not prefecture-specific).

The national detention ombuds's opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty: based on about 40 referrals since 2010, finds serious violations of fundamental rights persist across all places of detention; recommendations also apply to intersex and non-binary persons. National prison-system context.

Association for the Prevention of Torture blog: interview with the national detention ombuds about its 2021 opinion - trans persons deprived of liberty face constant risk of violence, discrimination and abuse; a new opinion was needed because the 2010 opinion had not resolved the problems. National prison-system context.
